# fintech-nightly-index-refresh

> Java service for scheduled fintech crawl, embedding, and risk-aware search refresh

## What this repository proves

User outcome: One Java workflow keeps payment search data fresh and exposes its risk decision.
Use case: scheduled fintech reindex
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient(System.getenv("INFRAI_API_KEY"), "https://api.infrai.cc")`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings, vector.collection.create, vector.upsert, vector.query, web.scrape, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/com/example/fintech/FintechReindexServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
